title: Cap each crew's driving

blocks.text: A home-care agency sends its nurses from one office to patients' homes. The labor agreement caps how long each nurse may spend driving in a day, the drive back to the office included, and the part-time nurses have a lower cap than the full-time ones. `shifts.py` builds one route per nurse, priced in drive minutes; `shifts[v]` is nurse `v`'s cap. Write `add_drive_limits(routing, drive_index, shifts)` so the model refuses any route that drives longer than its nurse's cap.
In the lesson's notation, with $`\text{drive}_i`$ the minutes driven on arrival at index $`i`$, $`s_v`$ and $`e_v`$ nurse $`v`$'s start and end, and $`c`$ the drive callback:
Before you code, say what slack this dimension needs, and which dimension call takes one cap per vehicle.
The tests ask the model whether hand-built routes are allowed (`ReadAssignmentFromRoutes`), so any correct dimension passes. One line.

from __future__ import annotations

from ortools.constraint_solver import pywrapcp


def add_drive_limits(routing, drive_index: int, shifts: list[int]) -> None:
    """Each crew v drives at most shifts[v] minutes, the drive back to the yard included."""
    routing.AddDimensionWithVehicleCapacity(drive_index, 0, list(shifts), True, "Drive")


def build(drive: list[list[int]], shifts: list[int]):
    """Given: one route per crew from the yard (node 0), priced in drive minutes."""
    manager = pywrapcp.RoutingIndexManager(len(drive), len(shifts), 0)
    routing = pywrapcp.RoutingModel(manager)

    def minutes(from_index, to_index):
        return drive[manager.IndexToNode(from_index)][manager.IndexToNode(to_index)]

    drive_index = routing.RegisterTransitCallback(minutes)
    routing.SetArcCostEvaluatorOfAllVehicles(drive_index)
    add_drive_limits(routing, drive_index, shifts)
    return manager, routing


if __name__ == "__main__":
    manager, routing = build([[0, 20, 30], [20, 0, 15], [30, 15, 0]], [60, 40])
    print(routing.ReadAssignmentFromRoutes([[1, 2], []], True) is not None)

cases.says: routes that drive no more than their crew's limit are allowed, and a route that drives more is refused
each crew is held to its own limit, so a route one crew may drive can be refused for a part-time crew
a route that drives exactly its crew's limit is allowed, and one minute more is refused

origin.section: A Dimension Accumulates a Quantity Along Each Route

concepts: a dimension's cumul grows by transit plus slack along a route and is capped by its capacity
